item.text: {"analysis":"The trial succeeded with host macro validation HR@10 of 0.540, improving on the reported prior 0.530 by 0.010 absolute. Category HR@10 was 0.560 for Movies_and_TV, 0.600 for Industrial_and_Scientific, 0.420 for Electronics, and 0.580 for CDs_and_Vinyl. Electronics improved from the reported prior 0.415 to 0.420, matching its reported baseline. These results support gated causal attention as a useful candidate, but one trial cannot establish that attention reliably caused the gain. Electronics remains the weakest category. No test results were available.","code_summary":"Each category independently trains one two-layer, 128-dimensional GRU with tied item embeddings and learned item bias. Single-head causal attention uses GRU states directly as queries, keys, and values; an elementwise sigmoid gate initialized with bias -2 adds its context through a residual connection before normalization, dropout, and output projection. Padding queries are handled safely. Training retains sampled cross-entropy with 256 shared negatives, training-window negative masking, and at most 2,048 target positions per batch. Checkpoints are selected by validation HR@10 with NDCG@10 tie-breaking. The generated predictor embeds the exact architecture and loads one selected checkpoint per category, preserving all four routes without ensembling."}
